industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

facts.claim: Cold Chain 3PL provides temperature‑controlled storage, handling, and transportation for perishable food, pharmaceutical products, and frozen goods.
facts.source_snippet: Cold Chain 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) refers to storing and transporting temperature-sensitive products that require constant temperature control, such as perishable food, pharmaceutical products, and frozen goods.

facts.claim: The company serves brands and marketing teams with temperature‑controlled fulfillment, offering services such as cold storage, pick‑and‑pack, kitting, insulated packaging, dry ice, and nationwide shipping.
facts.source_snippet: ColdChain3PL is built for brands and marketing teams that need reliable temperature-controlled fulfillment. We help food, beverage, wellness, ecommerce, and marketing companies store, kit, pack, and ship frozen, refrigerated, and ambient products with confidence. From cold storage, pick and pack, promotional kitting, distressed pallet projects, insulated packaging, dry ice, and gel packs to fast order processing and nationwide shipping, our team handles the complex fulfillment work...

facts.claim: Cold Chain 3PL claims to have 20 years of cold‑chain experience.
facts.source_snippet: With 20 years of cold-chain experience, ColdChain3PL gives growing brands and agencies a fulfillment partner they can trust to do it all.

facts.claim: The company emphasizes scalability, offering a flexible network of global, temperature‑controlled warehouses to handle seasonal demand spikes.
facts.source_snippet: Cold Chain 3PL is an industry leader in scalability for growth or seasonal demands. Thanks to their extensive network of global warehouses, they can quickly and easily manage fluctuations in demand and scale up to meet the needs of businesses large and small. With flexible storage options, including refrigerated and ambient temperature warehousing, they provide a range of temperature‑controlled solutions tailored to meet any short‑term or long‑term requirements.

facts.claim: Judd Rosenberg has over 20 years of leadership experience in gourmet, fresh‑prepared and grab‑and‑go products, previously co‑founded Food Evolution and led expansion through acquisitions of food processing plants in Texas and California.
facts.source_snippet: For over 20 years, Judd Rosenberg has been a noteworthy leader in the gourmet, fresh-prepared and grab‑n‑go products space... leading the vision of expansion with the acquisitions of a food processing plant in Texas and California based Fresh & Ready Foods.

facts.claim: Jamie Moriarty is an experienced entrepreneur recognized by InterCon as a 2020 Top 50 Tech Leader for his impact on the tech industry and innovation.
facts.source_snippet: Jamie Moriarty is an experienced entrepreneur... In addition to his primary job functions, Jamie has most recently been recognized by InterCon as a 2020 top 50 tech leader for his overall impact on the tech industry and spirit of innovation.

facts.claim: Cold Chain 3PL integrated an advanced order management system with real‑time inventory tracking, automated order processing, and strategic partnerships with local carriers, achieving a 30% increase in order processing efficiency and a 25% reduction in shipping times.
facts.source_snippet: Integrated an advanced order management system with real‑time inventory tracking, implemented automated order processing, and leveraged strategic partnerships with local carriers for faster last‑mile delivery... Achieved a 30% increase in order processing efficiency, reduced shipping times by 25%, and contributed to a notable surge in customer satisfaction.

facts.claim: Cold Chain 3PL provided logistics optimization for a meal‑delivery platform, introducing warehouse routing algorithms and a mix of national and last‑mile carriers to streamline operations.
facts.source_snippet: Challenge: Streamline the logistics for a meal delivery platform offering pre‑cooked meals... Solutions: Introduced warehouse routing optimization algorithms, utilized a combination of national and last mile carriers.
